title: maxDepth(0) is rejected at configuration time, before any document is seen
rationale: The synthetic-violation leg: a bound must reject nonsense, not clamp it. This also documents an unreachable fallback (the private constructor still contains a clamp the builder makes unreachable) and a compatibility break the code comments do not acknowledge.
catchesBugClass: A validation gate silently disappearing - the failure where a bound accepts garbage and clamps, converting a loud configuration error into quiet wrong behaviour on every subsequent document.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch anything about enforcement, only about acceptance. JsonReconstructor.maxDepth(0) throws from the same validation and is nonetheless completely inert at runtime - which is exactly how a dead control passes for a live one.

predicted.detail: Throws IllegalArgumentException during configuration - the input document is never parsed or flattened. Failing closed is right: a depth budget of zero has no coherent meaning and both alternatives (clamping, honouring) are worse.

configDescription: MapFlattener.builder().maxDepth(0) - expected to throw at build time
